verdict.rationale: jo's own docs describe giving it a job/schedule to run autonomously overnight on its own cloud machine and presenting a plan or summary for review in the morning, plus multi-step actions like building/publishing sites or managing Linear issues — matching the core of the story. However, this is all first-party marketing copy with no independent or hands-on verification of actual multi-step task completion or an explicit approve/reject review workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of autonomous task execution, and documented examples of a structured review/approval step before jo finalizes actions.
